Execution model: Application-native deterministic execution wherever the proposition can be faithfully represented; otherwise exact routing to an independent AI reviewer, capable external tool, human inspection, or external system
Primary objective: Maximize the probability that the final delivered product is actually correct while preventing unsupported confidence and minimizing opportunities for human or AI error.
This is an implementation task, not an audit, discussion, architecture exercise, or request for a downloadable patch.
1. Inspect the actual repository and establish the true current starting commit.
3. Preserve every working mechanism that satisfies this specification.
4. Correct every repository behavior that conflicts with this specification.
5. Implement the smallest complete changes necessary.
6. Test the application through the visible live user interface as a human operator would use it.
8. Test every affected downstream path after every upstream correction.
9. Preserve every reproduced defect as a permanent regression.
12. Use the deployed application through the real operator path before claiming completion.
1. Return an audit as a substitute for implementation.
2. Return a patch archive, downloadable bundle, replacement project, or instructions for the user to install manually as a substitute for modifying the actual application.
3. Stop after editing only Stage 01, Stage 04, or another isolated portion.
4. Declare success because source code looks correct.
5. Declare success because syntax tests pass.
6. Declare success because unit tests pass.
8. Declare success before replaying the exact failed user path in the live application.
10. Perform cleanup, refactoring, renaming, architecture modernization, or style changes that are not required to correct a demonstrated defect.
11. Rewrite working systems merely because another design is possible.
12. Create parallel stores, engines, parsers, prompt systems, shells, or workflow implementations.
13. Ask the user to repeat information the application already possesses.
14. Make the user manually allocate identifiers, calculate hashes, construct schemas, connect routine relationships, calculate gates, or retype canonical information.
15. Place instructions intended for external agents anywhere except the exact generated prompts controlled by prompt-engine.js.
Automated tests are mandatory, but they are not a substitute for live operator-path verification. Both are required.

One observable failure → identify the earliest responsible layer → apply one minimal complete correction → replay the exact visible path → verify affected downstream behavior → preserve the failure as a regression.

Section 0 directs only the implementation agent modifying and verifying the repository. Its instructions are not runtime project requirements, external-stage instructions, canonical project data, operator content, or prompt content. The application MUST NOT copy, paraphrase, display, store, export, or delegate Section 0 or other user-to-implementation-agent instructions into project records, operator screens, generated prompts, execution packages, schemas, or delivered artifacts unless a separate substantive product requirement expressly requires the same runtime behavior. prompt-engine.js contains only instructions needed by the external actor for the current project stage and operation.
The controlling disposition for every gate, stage determination, release determination, and terminal determination is evaluated in this exact order:
1.1 Any current sufficient refutation of an applicable mandatory proposition -> REJECTED.
1.2 Otherwise any required unknown, insufficiency, contradiction, stale state, unresolved blocker, or unavailable mandatory capability -> BLOCKED.
1.3 Otherwise every applicable mandatory proposition satisfied -> ACCEPTED.
1.4 All blockers and contradictions remain recorded even when REJECTED controls the disposition.
- The authoritative external prompt is a file, not clipboard contents or a rendered preview.
- The authoritative external response is an ingested JSON file, not pasted text.
- A human-origin answer stated only to an external agent remains an agent report until the application records human confirmation.
- A stage obligation is not due before its defined target exists and its EARLIEST_EXECUTABLE_STAGE has been reached.
- Authorization to deliver is not evidence that delivery occurred.
- Implementation instructions are not runtime agent instructions.

The controlling normative source is the exact UTF-8 file `specification/closed-loop-reliability-controlling-implementation-specification.txt` in the exact audited source commit. CI MUST generate `specification/closed-loop-specification-manifest.json` as a repository-only closed-loop-specification-manifest/1 after reading those exact bytes and MUST generate `specification/closed-loop-normative-requirements.json` as the corresponding normative-requirement manifest. That manifest records the source commit, repository path, artifact filename, byte length, SHA-256, section inventory, contract-profile identity, and the identity and digest of the normative-requirement manifest. The manifest and source commit together identify the exact specification used for implementation and acceptance; the specification does not contain a self-referential digest of itself.

The controlling runtime contract profile is closed-loop-completion-profile/1. Runtime project state, prompts, responses, packages, imports, exports, and receipts carry only the contract profile and the particular schema or registry identities required for their own operation. The specification text, its repository-only manifest, Section 0 implementation instructions, user-to-implementation-agent instructions, audits, and repair commentary are not runtime project data and MUST NOT be embedded in the application, generated prompts, execution packages, canonical records, or operator screens merely to establish conformance.

A closed-loop-project/3 object that lacks the current contract profile is legacy /3 data. It MUST be deterministically migrated with complete migration receipts or preserved as historical and non-gating. Schema-name equality alone does not establish current contract conformance.

Repository governance MUST maintain one machine-readable closed-loop-normative-requirements/1 manifest generated from and reviewed against the controlling specification. It assigns a stable NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT_ID to every distinct normative requirement, prohibition, invariant, field contract, operation contract, negative case, regression obligation, deployment obligation, and definition-of-done metric. Each entry records the controlling text location, responsible implementation owner, schema or registry entry, deterministic and semantic test IDs, mutation-test IDs, required browser or physical-device proof, acceptance-report field, and current disposition.

This manifest is implementation and acceptance evidence outside runtime project state. It MUST NOT be injected into ordinary project prompts or carried by the application as project content. CI rejects missing, duplicated, untraced, or conflicting normative entries and rejects an acceptance claim when any current mandatory entry lacks the required implementation and proof relationships.

Manifest completeness is established under the same omission-challenge discipline this specification imposes on project content. One extractor drafts the manifest from the controlling text; an independent reviewer that did not receive the draft performs its own extraction or section-by-section coverage pass; a distinct reconciliation resolves every difference; and every specification section is either covered by entries or explicitly recorded as nonnormative with a reason. CI records the challenge and reconciliation evidence with the manifest digest. An unreconciled material disagreement, an uncovered section, or a missing challenge record blocks acceptance.

For every external-agent operation, the application exports the exact authoritative prompt as a UTF-8 text file and exports any required manifest and input artifacts as files. stage_contracts.name: INITIALIZE THE JOB
stage_contracts.completion: Current input version exists; every required file reached its required inspection basis; every raw unit is accounted for; all blocking questions are resolved; every ask-now human issue was answered or explicitly deferred; required agent fields exist; the current proposal is accepted; any intent confirmation references the current input version and accepted change.

stage_contracts.name: BUILD THE SOURCE INVENTORY
stage_contracts.completion: The current bounded SOURCE_SEARCH_CONTRACT was executed; every supplied or discovered candidate source has a disposition; required search-adequacy review is accepted; material discovery risk and controlling conflicts are resolved or blocked. No universal source-completeness claim is made.

stage_contracts.name: RESEARCH THE REQUIREMENTS
stage_contracts.completion: Every current source and required source unit has current research coverage or Stage 02 validly established no applicable external source; conflict and exception passes and every triggered independent omission challenge and reconciliation are complete.

stage_contracts.name: COMPILE THE REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION
stage_contracts.completion: Every obligation has a valid disposition; every required disposition and atomicity challenge and reconciliation is complete; every resulting requirement and proposition is atomic enough to test, has provenance, and has observable satisfaction and failure conditions.

stage_contracts.name: RESOLVE THE REQUIREMENT SET
stage_contracts.completion: Every defect, proposition-equivalence issue, classification reduction, activation contract, applicability issue, proof-structure gap, and semantic disagreement is independently reviewed and resolved or blocked. Changed requirements receive a new version and invalidate downstream work.

stage_contracts.name: BUILD THE VERIFICATION SUITE BEFORE WRITING THE PRODUCTION INSTRUCTION
stage_contracts.completion: Every current applicable mandatory proposition has exactly one current proof obligation and an accepted proof expression; every due test has complete timing, semantic-coverage, evidence, independence, environment, and variance contracts; native tests use the current supported Test IR language and registry identities; unavailable mandatory capability remains blocked.

stage_contracts.name: BUILD FAILURE TESTS
stage_contracts.completion: Every applicable requirement has failure analysis. Every EXECUTABLE_NOW fixture was executed in isolated disposable state; every target-dependent fixture has a valid future trigger and required-by stage; expected and actual rejection agree; accepted invalid fixtures have validator defects.

stage_contracts.name: AUTHOR THE PRODUCTION INSTRUCTION
stage_contracts.completion: One current instruction exists. Every required section exists. Every mandatory requirement has a complete instruction trace.

stage_contracts.name: PREFLIGHT THE PRODUCTION INSTRUCTION
stage_contracts.completion: Independence exists, all clauses were reviewed, and no material finding remains unresolved.

stage_contracts.name: FREEZE THE TEST CANDIDATE
stage_contracts.completion: All required components are present and every run will receive the exact same frozen package.

stage_contracts.name: RUN TEN INDEPENDENT EXECUTIONS
stage_contracts.completion: Exactly ten current reserved runs and contexts exist; all responses are accepted; candidate and hashes match; contexts are distinct; contamination is absent; outputs and receipts are separate.

stage_contracts.name: VERIFY EACH EXECUTION INDEPENDENTLY
stage_contracts.completion: The complete current required relation set exists for every due PER_RUN_REQUIRED proposition, run, and test. Every verifier satisfies the semantic-review independence contract. Every required tuple has sufficient evidence and exactly one valid determination; no nondue or meaningless Cartesian cell is manufactured.

stage_contracts.name: COMPARE THE TEN EXECUTIONS
stage_contracts.completion: Every due PER_RUN_REQUIRED mandatory proposition has one comparison covering all ten current runs under its frozen expected-variance contract. Allowed variance is recorded; prohibited variance has a defect; UNKNOWN variance remains blocked.

stage_contracts.name: ROOT-CAUSE EVERY DEFECT
stage_contracts.completion: Every current material defect has one evidence-supported RCA. Unknown RCA remains blocked.

stage_contracts.name: CONVERT EVERY CONFIRMED FAILURE INTO A REGRESSION TEST
stage_contracts.completion: Every confirmed defect has a permanent definition and actual pre-correction execution proving failure. Later correction success comes from a distinct later execution.

stage_contracts.name: CORRECT THE ROOT CAUSE
stage_contracts.completion: Every confirmed RCA has a controlled correction or blocker; legitimate authorization exists; new versions are created; downstream work is invalidated.

stage_contracts.name: RE-RUN THE COMPLETE TEN-EXECUTION ITERATION
stage_contracts.completion: New iteration and candidate exist. The shared evaluator proves ten new runs, complete verification, comparison, RCA, regression execution, and correction behavior.

stage_contracts.name: CONTINUE UNTIL CONVERGENCE
stage_contracts.completion: Every current applicable PREPRODUCT_ITERATION obligation due by Stage 18 is SATISFIED; required per-run verification and applicable regression coverage equal 1.0; every due blocking defect, mandatory unknown, contradiction, ambiguity, and unexplained variance count is zero simultaneously. Later-phase product, representation, delivery, evidence, registry, and terminal obligations remain scheduled and are not falsely treated as due.

stage_contracts.name: RUN AN UNCHANGED CONFIRMATION ITERATION
stage_contracts.completion: Candidate versions and hashes are unchanged; ten new contexts exist; every due PREPRODUCT_ITERATION verification and regression executed; the independent requirement-discovery challenge is complete; no accepted new requirement candidate, missed due failure, material defect, contradiction, or unexplained variance exists.

stage_contracts.name: FREEZE THE PRODUCTION BASELINE
stage_contracts.completion: Unchanged confirmation succeeded; authorization exists; all components are present and immutable; baseline identity is recorded.

stage_contracts.name: GENERATE THE FINISHED PRODUCT
stage_contracts.completion: Product and execution identities exist; fresh production context was used; actual output bytes, inventory, hashes, and lineage are stored.

stage_contracts.name: RUN DETERMINISTIC VERIFICATION ON THE FINISHED PRODUCT
stage_contracts.completion: Every applicable mandatory deterministic test has exactly one current sufficient result and all mandatory results are satisfied.

stage_contracts.name: RUN INDEPENDENT MEANING-BASED VERIFICATION
stage_contracts.completion: Every meaning-review requirement has one independent current review with location, required meaning, observed meaning, comparison, evidence, and determination. No mandatory review is violated or undetermined.

stage_contracts.name: RUN ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION
stage_contracts.completion: Every applicable attack category and active historical regression pattern was tested. Findings have sufficient evidence. Every unresolved mandatory finding has a defect or blocker.

stage_contracts.name: INSPECT THE FINAL REPRESENTATION
stage_contracts.completion: DELIVERY_CANDIDATE_SET_ID is frozen; every artifact, representation, page, view, transformation, metadata-sensitive property, and packaged file in that exact set is inspected. Objective file facts are application-derived. Irreducible judgments use the proper human or reviewer authority. No mandatory representation unknown remains.

stage_contracts.name: RECONCILE PROCESS AND PRODUCT EVIDENCE
stage_contracts.completion: Current process and product audits exist; identities and counts are application-derived; discrepancies and contradictions are reconciled or blocked; both evidence bodies support progression.

stage_contracts.name: APPLY THE RELEASE GATE
stage_contracts.completion: Stage 26 is complete. CALCULATE_RELEASE applies the precedence in Section 36.4 and produces exactly one idempotent ACCEPTED, REJECTED, or BLOCKED result from the complete current due release-evidence universe.

stage_contracts.name: VERIFY ARTIFACT IDENTITY BEFORE RELEASE
stage_contracts.completion: Stage 27 is ACCEPTED. The exact Stage 25 DELIVERY_CANDIDATE_SET_ID is current. Audited and selected delivery bytes match that set one-to-one independent of order. Nothing is missing, extra, duplicated, unauthorized, renamed outside authorization, transformed, resized, or rehashed differently. Human delivery intent is destination-, purpose-, channel-, disclosure-, and validity-bound.

stage_contracts.name: PRESERVE THE COMPLETE EVIDENCE CHAIN
stage_contracts.completion: Every mandatory chain is structurally complete, current-scope, evidence-sufficient, and linked to current artifact identity where applicable.

stage_contracts.name: PRESERVE FAILURES PERMANENTLY AND CLOSE DELIVERY
stage_contracts.completion: Defect and regression histories are append-only; corrections are new records; every confirmed defect has a permanent regression; every due applicable regression execution is current; the pre-delivery checkpoint exists; CALCULATE_TERMINAL atomically creates one AUTHORIZED or BLOCKED delivery determination under Section 36.9. Export or share and any delivery completion are separately receipted and never inferred from authorization. Stage 30 closes through the one atomic CALCULATE_TERMINAL command, which reads the precondition revision, validates registry integrity and all terminal prerequisites, creates exactly one current terminal determination, sets DELIVERY_STATE = AUTHORIZED only when every prerequisite is true and otherwise BLOCKED, increments revision once, and commits once. The command's own committed revision does not invalidate its result; only a later revision affecting its dependency closure may supersede or withdraw it. Registry incompleteness blocks Stage 30 unless it proves an earlier premise false; it does not create a Stage 27↔Stage 30 cycle.
